snapshot_definitions.S0: last step with switch qpos == 0 before the ramp (switch OFF, pre-contact)
snapshot_definitions.S1: first step with switch qpos > 0.01 (contact, near floor)
snapshot_definitions.S2: first step with switch qpos >= 0.5*threshold (partial progress)
snapshot_definitions.S3: first step with switch qpos >= threshold-0.005 (near threshold, pre-success)
